method.inputs: packs/<house>.png (source elevations, variant X, variant Y), refs/PROTOCOL.md section 3, refs/DEV-K.md, NEW-B.md, NEW-C.md. Nothing else was opened.
method.verdicts: v = verdict against the model's own side names; vIfRotationIgnored given only where the model is consistently quarter-turned. Where a feature has several parts, OK means the majority is present at the drawn place and the note names what is missing.
method.counts: Wall doors, garage doors, windows and glazings only; roof windows are covered by the feature verdicts. Positions were measured as a percentage of wall length on enlarged crops.
method.usefulRule: PROTOCOL section 3. 'All F OK' was applied to the body, roof form, ridge direction and storey features (F1-F3); F4 items about eaves or shallow niches were treated as non-blocking, as the protocol says for eaves. This only matters for sakura X and is stated there.
method.identicalPairs: aurora, medulin, jeziorko, mindelo and g6: X and Y panels are pixel-identical (0 differing pixels in both the elevation strip and the axonometric strip). ballina: only a few pixels of wall height differ.
notJudged: Interiors, metric dimensions (out of scope of this verdict).
Aurora F1 'lower annex at the side': not visible in the four source elevations of the pack.
Ballina C1 chimneys: source shows none.
Materials only as flat colour zones; the renderer has no textures.
Left/right assignment of source side elevations is my own inference (chimneys, terrace furniture, niches), since the pack does not label the source images.
